name: ENENSYS Technologies S.A.
summary: ENENSYS Technologies SA specializes in developing and manufacturing advanced systems for digital television (TV) transmission and terrestrial broadcasting. Their product range encompasses essential broadcasting network equipment for digital terrestrial television (DTT), including capabilities for targeted content insertion, signal switching, and Internet Protocol (IP) transportation. The company also provides Long-Term Evolution (LTE) broadcasting technology, suitable for both portable "backpack" and broader "footprint" networks, alongside software solutions designed to facilitate video delivery across various broadcast and telecommunication platforms. Among their specific offerings are AdsEdge, a targeted content server and splicer; ATSCheduler, a broadcast gateway; DTTCaster for HDc, a terrestrial demodulator; and IPGuardV2, which provides IP stream switching functionalities. Founded in 2004, ENENSYS Technologies SA is headquartered in Cesson-Sevigne, France.
